chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Washshāʾ narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from ʿUmar ibn Yazīd, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام fell ill three times, and in each illness he would make a bequest; then when he recovered, he carried out his bequest.

key_terms.يُوصِي: he would make a bequest or will

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام deal with making a will during illness?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام would prepare a bequest whenever he became seriously ill. When he recovered, he would still fulfill what he had resolved, showing carefulness and seriousness regarding the matter of wills.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5549 - Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa' narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Umar ibn Yazid from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain (as), fell ill three times, and in each illness, he would make a will. When he recovered, he would carry out his will."
